g.text: Local-First Modular Monolith • Universal Case State Machine • Trigger-Enforced Append-Only Audit Ledger
One unified Progressive Web App (React 19 + TypeScript) tailored dynamically across 5 operational station personas
• Digital Gate Pass QR & Student Notices
HTTPS • REST JSON DTOs • IDEMPOTENCY TOKENS • OFFLINE SYNC REPLAY
Centralized OpenAPI 3.1 Contract Layer • Cryptographic Auth • Multi-Tenant Data Scoping Isolation
PyJWT Bearer Validation • Bcrypt Hashes • Role Matrix (Student/Staff/Admin) • Institution & Dept Scope Injection
Pydantic DTO Contract Engine & Public Verifier
Strict Request/Response Serialization • Sanitized AppError Hierarchy • Stateless Public QR Document Verifier
AUTHENTICATED CONTEXT • INJECTED TENANT SCOPE • STRICT PYDANTIC PAYLOADS
Autonomous Business Logic • 13 Pure Domain Engines (backend/app/services/) • High-Throughput State Machines
• Finite State Machine: SUBMITTED → TRIAGED → RESOLVED → CLOSED
• Unified Architecture for Complaints, Approvals, Passes & Docs
• Dynamic Workflow Step Sequencing & Multi-Approver Assignment
• Instant Actionable Policy Explanations on Rejection
• Sub-150ms Camera QR Validation & Rolling Verification Tokens
• Anti-Passback Defense: Strictly Prohibits Double-Exit / Re-entry
• Guard Override Mode with Explicit Incident Attribution Reason
• Business-Hour Window Computation & Due Date Calendar
• Real-time Status: ON_TIME • AT_RISK • BREACHED • MET • MISSED
• Automatic Department Allocation & Least-Loaded Staff Routing
• Idempotent Mutation Replay via Client UUIDs (Zero Duplication)
• Optimistic Concurrency Control (Version & Client Timestamp Check)
• Transparent Delta Synchronization for Spotty Campus Wi-Fi
• ReportLab PDF Generator (Bonafide, Leave Pass, NOC, Clearance)
• SHA-256 Tamper-Evident Serial Hashes & Embedded Verification QR
• Instant Third-Party Verification without System Login
• Asynchronous Background Outbox Drain with Exponential Backoff
• Multi-Channel Delivery: In-App Alerts • Telegram Bot • WhatsApp API
• Sentiment Analysis & Campus Duplicate Cluster Detection
• Strictly Human-in-the-Loop: Advisory-Only Behind RBAC Barrier
ATOMIC TRANSACTIONS • APPEND-ONLY EVENT SOURCING • TRIGGER LEDGER
PostgreSQL 16 Engine • Database Trigger-Enforced Immutability • Non-Repudiable Evidence Storage
Guaranteed by DB Triggers & ORM Listeners (app/models/immutability.py)
• AuditLog: Immutable snapshot of all actor mutations, headers & IP addresses
• CaseEvent: Tamper-proof lifecycle transition events with timestamps
• GateLog: Physical entry/exit barrier timestamps & security guard identity
⚡ HARD GUARANTEE: UPDATE and DELETE statements are unconditionally aborted at DB level
• Identity & Scoping: Users, Roles, Permissions, Campuses, Buildings, Units
• Workflows & Catalog: Services, SLA Policies, Workflow Steps, Escalations
• Case State Store: CampusCase, Passes, Feedback, Attributed Evidence, Notes
⚡ Complete ACID transaction safety wrapped in session_scope() context manager
Guaranteed Zero Message Loss & Deterministic Migrations
• Transactional Outbox: notification_deliveries table ensures at-least-once sends
• Exponential Backoff: Automatic delivery retries for Telegram, WhatsApp & Push
• Alembic Versioning: Strict schema migration chain with deterministic test seeders
⚡ No external Redis or RabbitMQ required — zero operational complexity
Campus Relay • Engineered by Crystal Studio Labs • BPUT Hackathon 2026 (Problem Statement 07: Fretbox)
Strict Transaction Atomicity • Complete Cognitive Clarity • Low Deployment Friction • Production Ready
